description: This file contains server-side logic for the StartExam page of an online examination system, handling user session validation, course selection based on semester, starting theory or MCQ exams, and checking if the user has already taken specific exams.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for managing exam start process, including loading courses based on semester, initiating exams, and checking exam status.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the page load event, checks user session, retrieves user semester info, and populates course dropdown based on semester.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the user profile page.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Redirects user to the leaderboard page.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Starts the selected exam based on user's choice of exam type (Theory or MCQ), checks for available questions, and sets session variables.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of a theory exam, checks if already taken, and initiates exam if not.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Handles selection of an MCQ exam, checks if already taken, and initiates exam if not.
